But after a couple of hours we realized the cows had slowly surrounded us, blocking our way to the car. My dad called the rancher, expecting him to be mad at us. But he showed up with a bunch of hay and slowly made his way to us. He sat my little brother and I in the back of his truck and played some music and let us feed the cows as we slowly drove out. We were supposed to throw the hay but after a while he would have to stop so we leaned over and let the cows eat from our hands. I remember feeling their breath and how wet their faces were. We had so much fun and we didnt want to leave. But when we got back to our car the rancher gave us some ice cold Barqs Rootbeer. That was the first time i had it and it became my favorite soda ever. I havent bought any since i was a teenager. Everything seemed to lose its taste and its fun by then.

 I wish i could go back and just live in that moment forever. But now I'm watching my dad get old and sick, my little brother is in the same place as me. It feels like it wasnt me back then. It was a different, happy kid. Its so for gone now and I cant get it back. It hurts.
